ranked.title: Image-guided alignment of consecutive multi-modal tissue slides
ranked.reason: COAST is a technically strong, immediately useful alignment method for consecutive spatial transcriptomic and metabolomic/lipidomic sections, demonstrated in kidney ischemia-reperfusion injury.

ranked.title: IRAP deficiency preserves renal function and attenuates pathology in aged mice
ranked.reason: A mechanistic and pharmacological study connecting IRAP inhibition to preserved filtration, reduced fibrosis and reduced proximal-tubule senescence in aged kidneys.

ranked.title: Ageas enables time-agnostic cell fate inference from single-cell and spatial multi-omics data
ranked.reason: A transfer-learning framework for fate-bias inference from static single-cell, epigenomic and spatial snapshots, with direct relevance to disease-state trajectory analysis.

ranked.title: Immature Neutrophil Phenotype and Enhanced Myeloperoxidase in Male Patients With Chronic Kidney Disease and Cardiovascular Comorbidity
ranked.reason: Human cardio-renal translational biology with two CKD cohorts, highlighting a reproducible immature neutrophil/MPO phenotype while also exposing important cohort limitations.

ranked.title: Gene-Chronos: parameter-efficient developmental time inference using a pretrained single-cell foundation model
ranked.reason: A relevant foundation-model method, but less kidney-specific than the selected computational paper.

ranked.title: Renal outcomes associated with sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitor use in kidney transplant recipients with type 2 or posttransplant diabetes
ranked.reason: Highly translational real-world evidence, but retrospective and less methodologically distinctive for this week's mix.

ranked.title: Dual-Matrix Platform for Highly Specific Multi-Omics Profiling of Renal Cell Carcinoma
ranked.reason: Technically interesting renal-cancer multi-omics platform, held as an alternate to keep episode scope coherent.

classic.title: Single-cell transcriptomics of the mouse kidney reveals potential cellular targets of kidney disease
classic.reason: Today's Classic: the 2018 Susztak-lab kidney atlas that profiled 57,979 cells, linked monogenic disease genes to cell types, and identified collecting-duct transitional states.
